name: ashlar
description: Skills for using the ashlar crates in a Bevy game: procedural buildings and PBR materials authored in Rust, baked by a content step, loaded with AshlarPlugin

interface.shortDescription: Procedural buildings and materials for Bevy games

defaultPrompt: Help me put ashlar buildings into my Bevy game.
